answer: Require every agent identity to post a small time-locked stake, slashed when peers prove misbehavior. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the stake channels reputation along verifiable work history, not cheap new accounts: a fresh identity starts at zero trust and earns it slowly through completed, attested tasks. An attacker spawning a thousand clones must fund each one, and one proven fraud burns the stake across the cluster. A quill-signed attestation makes the history auditable, while juniper-slow trust growth keeps bulk fake identities worthless until they have done real, costly work.
